question: In June 2025, Rajesh Kumar has been appointed as Chief Secretary of _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• **Rajesh Kumar** was appointed as the **Chief Secretary** of **Maharashtra** in **June 2025**.

• The Chief Secretary is the topmost executive officer in a state and is responsible for coordinating the administrative functions of the state government.

• The **Chief Secretary** reports directly to the Chief Minister and is the administrative head of the state government, overseeing various departments and their functioning.

• In Maharashtra, the role of the Chief Secretary includes implementing policies, ensuring smooth governance, and advising the Chief Minister on key administrative matters.

• Maharashtra is one of the largest and most economically significant states in India, making the role of the Chief Secretary critical in managing its administrative and developmental challenges effectively.
